worked_solution:
The local truncation error (LTE) is the error made in a *single step* of a numerical method, when the step begins from an *exact value*. The LTE of a numerical method at step $n$ from $x$ with exact value ${y}_{\text{exact}}(x)$ to ${x}_{\text{new}}=x+Δx$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{τ}_{n} & ={y}_{\text{exact}}({x}_{\text{new}})-{y}_{\text{new}} \\  & ={y}_{\text{exact}}({x}_{\text{new}})-({y}_{\text{exact}}(x)+Δy).\end{aligned}
$$

We find the LTE at each step, rounding to three decimal places in each case:

- After the first step, we have ${x}_{\text{new}}=0.17$ and ${y}_{\text{new}}=0.751.$ So, the LTE of the first step is

$$
\begin{aligned}{τ}_{1} & ={y}_{\text{exact}}(0.17)-0.751 \\  & =((0.17)^{2}+\frac{1}{1+2(0.17)})-0.751 \\  & ≈0.024.\end{aligned}
$$

- After the second step, we have ${x}_{\text{new}}=0.34$ and ${y}_{\text{new}}=0.738.$ So, the LTE of the second step is

$$
\begin{aligned}{τ}_{2} & ={y}_{\text{exact}}(0.34)-0.738 \\  & =((0.34)^{2}+\frac{1}{1+2(0.34)})-0.738 \\  & ≈-0.027.\end{aligned}
$$

- After the third step, we have ${x}_{\text{new}}=0.51$ and ${y}_{\text{new}}=0.724.$ So, the LTE of the third step is

$$
\begin{aligned}{τ}_{3} & ={y}_{\text{exact}}(0.51)-0.724 \\  & =((0.51)^{2}+\frac{1}{1+2(0.51)})-0.724 \\  & ≈0.031.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the completed table is as given below.

| $n$ | $x$ | $y$ | ${τ}_{n}$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $0$ | $0$ | $1.000$ | $0$ |
| $1$ | $0.17$ | $0.751$ | $0.024$ |
| $2$ | $0.34$ | $0.738$ | $-0.027$ |
| $3$ | $0.51$ | $0.724$ | $0.031$ |
html:
The local truncation error (LTE) is the error made in a single step of a numerical method, when the step begins from an exact value. The LTE of a numerical method at step n from x with exact value yexact(x) to xnew=x+Δx is τn=yexact(xnew)−ynew=yexact(xnew)−(yexact(x)+Δy).

We find the LTE at each step, rounding to three decimal places in each case:

  • After the first step, we have xnew=0.17 and ynew=0.751. So, the LTE of the first step is τ1=yexact(0.17)−0.751=((0.17)2+11+2(0.17))−0.751≈0.024.

  • After the second step, we have xnew=0.34 and ynew=0.738. So, the LTE of the second step is τ2=yexact(0.34)−0.738=((0.34)2+11+2(0.34))−0.738≈−0.027.

  • After the third step, we have xnew=0.51 and ynew=0.724. So, the LTE of the third step is τ3=yexact(0.51)−0.724=((0.51)2+11+2(0.51))−0.724≈0.031.

Therefore, the completed table is as given below.

n x y τn
0 0 1.000 0
1 0.17 0.751 0.024
2 0.34 0.738 −0.027
3 0.51 0.724 0.031
